description: THE QUERY TOOL: finds instruments matching criteria within one asset class and returns a ranked list. Filters on minimum Martingale Score, minimum Startingale, exchange, round count, sector and count. It is the only tool that filters on exchange, round count or a minimum Martingale Score; list_top_crypto and list_top_stocks take only a count, a Startingale floor and a sector, and the overviews take no arguments. Answers in formatted text. Costs 3 units of the monthly quota.

exchange.description: Keep only instruments that venue lists. Exactly one of: binance, kraken_pro (with an underscore), hyperliquid. This is a listing fact about the market, reported for callers who run their own execution, not a statement about where to trade. Tradingale never places orders, holds funds, or gives advice. Crypto only, stocks ignore it. Without it, every venue.

limit.description: How many to return, highest Martingale Score first. 1-20, default 10.

min_martingale.description: Keep only instruments at or above this Martingale Score. Scale 0-5, higher means the price behaviour fits the sequence structure better. Default: 0 (no filter).

min_startingale.description: Keep only instruments at or above this Startingale reading: how well the CURRENT price sits versus the structure, unlike the Martingale Score which is about behaviour over time. Scale 0-5: 4.3 and above reads Strong, 3.7 and above Favorable, 3 and above Moderate, below that Misaligned. Default: 0 (no filter).

rounds.description: Keep only instruments whose sequence has this many rounds: the total number of orders, initial round included (4 or 5). Without it, both.

sector.description: Keep only instruments in this sector: exact label, case-insensitive. Crypto (source: Tradingale), one of: Layer 1, Layer 2, DeFi, Artificial Intelligence, Meme, Real World Assets, Privacy, Payments, DePIN & Storage, Gaming & Metaverse, Exchange Tokens, Infrastructure, Other. US stocks (source: SEC SIC): the sector label shown by get_instrument, e.g. Software & IT, Banks, Pharma & Biotech, Semiconductors. Without it, every sector.

type.description: Which catalogue to search. One at a time, not both. Default: crypto.
